applications.en: Headlines center on model and agent launches, scaling agent coordination, and LLM price cuts, pointing to brisk AI application and commercialization activity.
applications.zh: 标题集中在模型与智能体产品发布、智能体协作规模化以及模型降价，反映 AI 应用与商业化的密集动向。

chips_compute.en: Headlines focus on compute supply and hardware: scheduling gains for usable GPUs, new chip products, large GPU financing, and trillion-parameter deployments.
chips_compute.zh: 多则标题聚焦算力供给与硬件：调度优化提升可用的 GPU、新芯片产品、大规模 GPU 融资与万亿参数模型部署，显示算力议题升温。

funding_ma.en: Headlines cover IPO filings, a GPU financing deal, an acquisition, and talk of a burst AI bubble in China, pointing to active funding and M&A news.
funding_ma.zh: 多则标题涉及上市文件、GPU 融资交易、并购与中国 AI 泡沫讨论，指向融资与并购话题活跃。
